samples.title: Hostile invoices
samples.blurb: A Python billing library whose test suite tries rm -rf, steals env vars, spawns a process storm, eats memory and hangs forever. It also hides two real bugs.

samples.title: Notes API
samples.blurb: A small Node.js notes service with token auth and file attachments. Two holes hide in plain sight.

samples.title: Vuln vault
samples.blurb: A Solidity ETH vault with a reentrancy hole and an open owner setter. ProofBox writes Foundry exploits and runs them offline.
